q: The points $(20\,{}^\circ\text{C};\ 110\,\text{kPa})$ and $(70\,{}^\circ\text{C};\ 128\,\text{kPa})$ are read from the line. Calculate the slope of the line.
The result was $\theta_0 = -270 \pm 12\,{}^\circ\text{C}$. Does the result agree with the value $-273.15\,{}^\circ\text{C}$?
a: It does. The uncertainty interval is $-282\,{}^\circ\text{C} \ldots -258\,{}^\circ\text{C}$, and the accepted value $-273.15\,{}^\circ\text{C}$ lies in it.
